description: Workflows: a chain of commands over sets of records, written down once and run with /workflow:run — the progress lives on the records.

dreamteamer.title: Workflows
dreamteamer.description: `workflows`: a chain of commands written down — each step a command, the records it walks (a `dt list --where` filter) and where a person decides. `/workflow:run <id>` walks one with `dt next` and records nothing about the run: the records the commands touch are the progress. `npx dt-workflows install <id>` copies a shipped workflow in; `customer-factory` ships here.
